items.title: Apache Log4j2 JNDI RCE (Log4Shell)
items.summary: Apache Log4j2 JNDI features do not protect against attacker controlled LDAP and other JNDI related endpoints, permitting arbitrary code execution.

items.title: Spring Framework RCE via Data Binding (Spring4Shell)
items.summary: A Spring MVC or Spring WebFlux application running on JDK 9+ may be vulnerable to remote code execution via data binding parameter tampering.

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an SQL Command ('SQL Injection')
items.summary: The software constructs all or part of an SQL command using externally-influenced input without neutralization, enabling database tampering.

items.title: OpenSSH Server Signal Handler Race Condition (regreSSHion)
items.summary: A signal handler race condition in OpenSSH server (sshd) allows unauthenticated remote code execution as root in glibc-based Linux environments.

items.title: Polkit pkexec Local Privilege Escalation (PwnKit)
items.summary: A local privilege escalation vulnerability was found in the polkit pkexec utility allowing unprivileged users to obtain root access.

items.title: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
items.summary: The software constructs an OS command using externally-influenced input without proper neutralization, executing arbitrary shell commands.
